extraction.name: SCIENCE QA
extraction.description: A new benchmark of about 21k multimodal multiple-choice science questions with diverse science topics, annotated with answers, lectures, and explanations. It is designed to study chain-of-thought reasoning in science question answering.
extraction.creator: Pan Lu, Swaroop Mishra, Tony Xia, Liang Qiu, Kai-Wei Chang, Song-Chun Zhu, Oyvind Tafjord, Peter Clark, Ashwin Kalyan
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The paper states that the dataset was collected as SCIENCEQA, a multimodal multiple-choice science question dataset, and refers readers to Appendix A.1 for data collection details.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: A multimodal multiple-choice science question dataset with 21,208 examples, covering natural science, social science, and language science, with text context, image context, lectures, and explanations.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Most questions are annotated with grounded lectures and detailed explanations; the lecture provides general knowledge and the explanation reveals a specific reason for the answer.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Generated lectures and explanations were evaluated by automatic metrics and human scores by annotators.
